title: Blake: A Reproducible, Rights-Bounded William Blake Corpus Workflow
description: Blake builds a reproducible local corpus workflow for William Blake texts, images, metadata, analysis results, visual summaries, exports, and reports. It pairs an auditable canonical target ledger with a fail-closed rights gate that separates open-source code and project-authored aggregate analytics from provider-supplied Blake Archive TEI, transcriptions, images, and fallback source texts. The MIT license covers project code and project-authored outputs only; provider-supplied source materials and the local evidence cache are excluded from the public release and remain under their source-provider terms.
notes: MIT covers project code and project-authored aggregate outputs only.
